mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE job_key=#{jobKey}

SELECT id,user_id FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE status='QUEUED' AND next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM studyroom_generation_jobs running WHERE running.user_id=studyroom_generation_jobs.user_id AND running.status='RUNNING') ORDER BY priority DESC,created_at,id LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='RUNNING'
SELECT * FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE id=#{jobId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE id=#{jobId} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE studyroom_generation_jobs SET lease_until=#{leaseUntil},heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{jobId} AND lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE studyroom_generation_jobs SET status='SUCCEEDED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{jobId} AND lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE studyroom_runs SET state_version=state_version+1 WHERE id=#{runId}
UPDATE studyroom_units SET status='FAILED',error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage} WHERE id=#{unitId} AND status<>'READY'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE status='RUNNING' AND lease_until<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studyroom_generation_calls WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND status='SENT'
mapper.update: UPDATE studyroom_generation_calls SET status='UNCERTAIN',failure_code='MODEL_CALL_UNCERTAIN' WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND status='SENT'
UPDATE studyroom_generation_jobs SET status='FAILED',failure_code='MODEL_CALL_UNCERTAIN', failure_message='模型调用结果未保存，前次可能已消耗额度。可主动重试。' WHERE id=#{jobId}
UPDATE studyroom_units SET status='FAILED',error_code='MODEL_CALL_UNCERTAIN', error_message='调用结果未保存，前次可能已消耗额度。' WHERE id=#{unitId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM study_outline_drafts WHERE id=#{draftId} AND pending_job_id=#{jobId}
SELECT * FROM study_outline_revisions WHERE draft_id=#{draftId} AND revision=#{revision}

SELECT f.*,u.unit_spec_json,d.question,d.chapter_id FROM studyroom_fragments f JOIN studyroom_units u ON u.id=f.unit_id JOIN studyroom_runs r ON r.id=f.run_id JOIN study_outline_drafts d ON d.id=r.draft_id WHERE f.id=#{fragmentId}
